papers.title: DermDepth: Toward Monocular Metric Scale 3D Reconstruction Models for Dermatology
papers.authors: Héctor Carrión, Narges Norouzi
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz, USA; University of California, Berkeley, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出DermDepth，通过合成数据集D-Synth微调仅0.6%参数，矫正了基础单目深度模型在皮肤科图像上的系统性尺度错误（误差从16倍降至1.1倍以内），并在三个真实基准上实现公平的肤色表现和临床可行的病变测量。

papers.title: X-Lens: Real-Time Metric Depth Estimation with Heterogeneous Cameras
papers.authors: Heng Zhou, Shuhong Liu, Yonghao He, Bohao Zhang, Fa Fu, Chenhui Hou, Xianbao Hou, Lijun Han, Wei Sui
papers.affiliations: 1D-Robotics, 2The University of Tokyo, 3Soochow University（具体作者机构见第十二节）
papers.intro: X-Lens 是一个轻量级前馈模型，通过可学习校准令牌和基于雅可比矩阵的畸变偏置，在混合鱼眼与针孔相机配置中实现实时、度量深度估计，并在大规模合成数据集OmniScene上训练，以0.04B参数达到41 FPS，性能优于现有方法。

papers.title: ViCo3D: Empowering LiDAR-based Collaborative 3D Object Detection with Vision Foundation Models
papers.authors: Haojie Ren, Songrui Luo, Lingfeng Wang, Yan Xia, Yao Li, Jing Li, Lu Zhang, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China
papers.intro: ViCo3D通过将点云投影为BEV图像并利用DINOv2提取视觉特征，再与LiDAR几何特征进行多尺度融合，首次将视觉基础模型应用于LiDAR协同3D目标检测，实现了SOTA性能。

papers.title: Point Tracking in Surgery--The 2025 Surgical Tattoos in Infrared Challenge (STIRC2025)
papers.authors: Adam Schmidt, Mert Asim Karaoglu, Zijian Wu, Jiaming Zhang, Yuxin Chen, Tim Salcudean, Ho-Gun Ha, Minkang Jang, Kyungmin Jung, Ihsan Ullah, Hyunki Lee, Suresh Guttikonda, Sarah Latus, Alexander Schlaefer, Xinkai Zhao, Yuichiro Hayashi, Masahiro Oda, Takayuki Kitasaka, Kensaku Mori, Peng Liu, Chenyang Li, Stefanie Speidel, Aoife Gardiner, Agostino Stilli, Danail Stoyanov, Francisco Vasconcelos, Anwesa Choudhuri, Meng Zheng, Zhongpai Gao, Benjamin Planche, Van Nguyen Nguyen, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu, Alexander Ladikos, Omid Mohareri
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文中作者所属机构分散在多个单位，但未给出统一的所属机构字段，详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文介绍了2025年外科纹绣红外挑战赛（STIRC2025），通过公开数据集STIR和标准化评估指标，对七支参赛团队的手术点跟踪算法进行了精度与效率的量化评测，并总结了方法与结果。

papers.title: UniMedSeg: Unified In-Context Learning for Multi-Paradigm 2D/3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Yunzhou Li, Jiesi Hu, Yanwu Yang, Hanyang Peng, Chenfei Ye, Jianfeng Cao, Yixuan Yuan, Ting Ma
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology at Shenzhen, Peng Cheng Laboratory, University Hospital Tübingen, German Center for Mental Health, Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: UniMedSeg 是一个基于 Transformer 的统一医学图像分割框架，通过将视觉示例、几何交互、语言指令和2D/3D图像映射到共享序列空间，并引入解耦分割注意力（Decoupled Split Attention）解决长序列瓶颈，实现了多种分割范式的零样本泛化，无需任务特定微调。

papers.title: Inhibited Self-Attention: Sharpening Focus in Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Peter R. D. van der Wal, Nicola Strisciuglio, George Azzopardi
papers.tags: vision transformer, image classification, object detection
papers.affiliations: University of Groningen, University of Twente, Stellenbosch University, University of Malta
papers.intro: 本文提出抑制自注意力（ISA），通过保留并利用标准softmax丢弃的负注意力分数来抑制无关特征，从而锐化ViT对目标区域的关注，并在多个鲁棒性基准上提升性能，且不增加额外参数或计算量。

papers.title: Metric-Guided Synthetic Image Data Rendering for Deep Learning compatible with Agentic AI
papers.authors: Martina Radoynova, Samuel Pantze, Trina De, Ulrik Günther, Artur Yakimovich
papers.tags: image generation, object detection, instance segmentation, medical image
papers.affiliations: Center for Advanced Systems Understanding (CASUS), Görlitz, Germany; Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf e. V. (HZDR), Dresden, Germany; Institute of Computer Science, University of Wrocław, Wrocław, Poland; Cluster of Excellence Physics of Life, TU Dresden, Dresden, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出GraNatPy包，通过FID、dNf和熵等量化指标引导合成图像数据的真实感与多样性优化，并在病毒斑块检测任务中验证了指标与零样本目标检测性能的关联，同时将流程包装为Agentic AI技能SynthClaw实现自动化参数优化。

papers.title: AVSCap: Orchestrating Audio-Visual Synergy for Omni-modal Video Captioning
papers.authors: Yanghai Wang, Jiahao Wang, Jiafu Tang, Yuanxing Zhang, Zhe Cao, Hanyan Bian, Zijie Zhang, Weiliang Luo, Zhiyu Pan, Zixuan Dong, Jiaheng Liu, Zhaoxiang Zhang
papers.affiliations: 1 NJU-LINK Team, Nanjing University; 2 Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology; 3 Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: AVSCap通过解耦-融合数据管道构建训练语料、两阶段训练策略（SFT+GRPO）和细粒度事件评估基准，实现了显式的跨模态事件绑定，显著提升非语音音频覆盖率和音频-视觉协同能力。

papers.title: Towards Vision-Free CIR: Attribute-Augmented Scoring and LLM-Based Reranking for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Ryotaro Shimada, Yu-Chieh Lin, Yuji Nozawa, Youyang Ng, Osamu Torii, Yusuke Matsui
papers.affiliations: The University of Tokyo；Kioxia Corporation
papers.intro: 本文提出首个完全Vision-Free的零样本CIR框架，通过属性增强混合评分（Attribute-Augmented Hybrid Scoring）补偿文本丢失的细粒度视觉细节，并利用LLM重排序（LLM-Based Reranking）验证候选与查询的语义一致性，在CIRR数据集上以44.04%…

papers.title: What Does a Temporal Benchmark Score Measure? Decomposing Channel Use in Video VLM Evaluation
papers.authors: Farrukh Rahman
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, video generation, video search
papers.affiliations: Microsoft; Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种无需标注的"反转下降"（reversal-drop）筛查方法，通过将视觉帧序列反转而保持RoPE位置编码正向，来分解视频VLM在时间基准测试中使用的信息通道，揭示模型是位置主导型还是视觉序列主导型。

papers.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Runhui Huang, Qihui Zhang, Zhe Liu, Yu Gao, Jie Wu, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, ByteDance Seed, Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出SpectraReward，一种无需训练的奖励函数，通过计算生成图像条件下的平均提示似然来利用预训练MLLM的图像-文本对齐能力，并进一步提出Self-SpectraReward实现在统一多模态模型中的闭环自改进。

papers.title: Latent-Identity Tuning in Text-to-Image Personalization Models
papers.authors: Daniel Garibi, Ronen Kamenetsky, Hadar Averbuch-Elor, Daniel Cohen-Or, Or Patashnik
papers.affiliations: 1Tel Aviv University, 2Cornell University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的方法，通过分析预训练冻结编码器的隐空间，发现并利用语义方向对身份令牌进行细粒度、局部化的编辑，实现身份表示的直接调优。

papers.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Shijie Wang, Honglu Zhou, Ziyang Wang, Ran Xu, Caiming Xiong, Silvio Savarese, Chen Sun, Juan Carlos Niebles
papers.affiliations: Salesforce AI Research, Palo Alto, CA, USA; Brown University, Providence, RI, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出证据支持的视频问答（E-VQA）任务，要求模型同时输出语义答案、相关时间片段和密集跟踪的分割掩码，并构建了人工验证的基准ST-Evidence和160k规模指令微调数据集ST-Evidence-Instruct，通过微调显著提升联合推理和像素级证据定位性能。

papers.title: HASTE: A Platform for Rapid Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment
papers.authors: Caleb Robinson, Anthony Ortiz, Simone Fobi Nsutezo, Cameron Birge, Meygha Machado, Marcelo Duarte, Joaquin Rivero Rodriguez, Anthony Cintron Roman, Kevin White, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Juan M. Lavista Ferres
papers.affiliations: Microsoft AI for Good Research Lab
papers.intro: HASTE是一个无代码网页平台，通过仅需少量标注的两种方法（单场景语义分割或足迹嵌入+浏览器内分类器），让非机器学习专家在数小时内从灾后卫星影像生成每栋建筑的损伤图，已支持2023年以来30多次真实灾害响应。

papers.title: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency
papers.authors: Zihan Su, Teng Hu, Jiangning Zhang, Ruiyan Wang, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Dacheng Tao
papers.affiliations: Zihan Su, Teng Hu, Ruiyan Wang, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma - 上海交通大学；Jiangning Zhang - 浙江大学；Dacheng Tao - 南洋理工大学
papers.intro: Cycle-World通过强制时间可逆性（循环一致性）在训练和推理阶段约束前向生成漂移，显著抑制了长视频自回归生成中的误差累积和结构性幻觉。

papers.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
papers.authors: Kaixin Ma, Di Feng, Alexander Metz, Jiarui Lu, Eshan Verma, Afshin Dehghan
papers.affiliations: Apple
papers.intro: 提出MM-ToolSandBox，一个统一的基准和评估框架，用于多轮、多图像、大工具空间（500+工具）下的视觉工具调用代理评估，通过258个人工验证场景和50个UI变体测试12个SOTA模型，发现即使最强模型成功率低于50%，且视觉精度而非规划能力是主要瓶颈。

papers.title: StoryTeller: Training-Free Narrative Grounding for Long-Form Audio Description
papers.authors: Seung Hyun Hahm, Minh T. Dinh, SouYoung Jin
papers.affiliations: Dartmouth College, USA
papers.intro: StoryTeller提出一种无需训练的长格式音频描述框架，通过显式的叙事记忆机制（身份图 + 显著性权重记忆）跨场景传播故事相关信息，显著提升叙述连贯性和事实依据，且仅需原始视频和电影标题。

papers.title: Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer
papers.authors: Jordão Bragantini, Ilan Theodoro, Loïc A. Royer
papers.affiliations: Biohub
papers.intro: 本文提出一种以边为中心的Transformer架构（HOCT），通过几何驱动的边自注意力机制绕过无信息候选图拓扑，并利用线到线距离编码解决细胞分裂导致的节点嵌入纠缠问题，在不依赖深度预训练图像编码器的情况下在细胞跟踪挑战中取得最佳结果。

papers.title: NeuralActuator: Neural Actuation Modeling for Robot Dynamics and External Force Perception
papers.authors: Zhiyang Dou, John U. Onyemelukwe, Hangxing Zhang, Heng Zhang, Minghao Guo, Yunsheng Tian, Michal Piotr Lipiec, Joshua Jacob, Chao Liu, Peter Yichen Chen, Yuri Ivanov, Wojciech Matusik
papers.affiliations: MIT, Amazon Robotics
papers.intro: 本文提出NeuralActuator，一种数据驱动的神经执行器模型，联合预测广义力替代量、外力（含接触概率门控）和电机状态分数，并通过可微仿真从位姿轨迹进行训练，显著提升了低成本机器人平台的动力学建模精度和无传感器外力感知能力。

papers.title: GFR-SAM: Training-Free Referring Camouflaged Object Segmentation via Cross-Image Prompting
papers.authors: Yilong Yang, Jianxin Tian, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, visual grounding, Segment Anything
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University
papers.intro: 提出GFR-SAM，一个三阶段训练-free框架，通过“生成-过滤-精炼”流程，利用SAM3的跨图像上下文提示（In-Context Exemplar）取代脆弱点匹配，实现稳健的伪装目标分割。
